vix_assessment: VIX at 19 (-7.72%) signals fear unwinding. Below 20 is constructive, but not complacent yet. Market has absorbed recent shocks and institutional buying is visible in midcaps/smallcaps. Conviction plays should be accumulated.
sector_rotation: Money flowing OUT of defensives (IT -1.91%) INTO cyclicals: Auto (+2.85%), Banks (+1.99%), PSU Banks (+2.01%), Realty (+2.08%), Next 50 (+2.07%). Midcap indices leading (up 1.5-2.1%) = risk-on mode. FIIs still net sellers (-₹1,711Cr) but DIIs absorbing (+₹956Cr). Strong domestic institutional support creates floor.

stock_picks.rationale: Power transmission T&D equipment leader with ₹16,000Cr order book (2.5x revenue). ROCE 22%, ROE 21%, zero debt. stock_picks.name: AIA Engineering Limited
stock_picks.rationale: Global leader in high-chrome grinding media with 55% market share. ROCE 28%, ROE 23%, debt-free. Revenue mix: 70% exports (USD earner = rupee hedge). Consistent 20%+ ROE for 10 years = quality compounder.
stock_picks.risk_factors: Above ₹1000 price point, China dumping risk, global mining slowdown, raw material cost volatility

stock_picks.name: Finolex Cables Limited

stock_picks.rationale: Basmati rice exporter (Royal, Daawat brands) with 60% revenue from exports. ROCE 15%, improving to 18% with new capacity. Debt/equity reduced to 0.4 from 0.8. Geopolitical tensions (Red Sea) benefit Indian exporters vs Pakistan. FMCG rotation visible (Nifty FMCG +1.16%).

stock_picks.name: Sequent Scientific Limited

Carlyle invested ₹400Cr at ₹160 (March 2023) = strong hands. Niche sector with limited listed peers. Europe regulatory approvals for 3 products awaited = re-rating trigger.

Discovery + development services margin expansion (currently 28% EBITDA). Capacity addition 30% FY24-26 = volume leverage.

Remaining 60% (₹3L) in stocks: 50% in large/midcaps under ₹1000 (₹1.5L split: FINCABLES ₹30K, LTFOODS ₹25K, GPIL ₹30K, RVNL ₹25K, BEL ₹20K, LXCHEM ₹20K). 30% in quality above ₹1000 (₹90K: AIA ₹30K, BRIGADE ₹30K, SYNGENE ₹30K). 20% in high-conviction smallcaps (₹60K: SEQUENT ₹20K, PARAS ₹20K, IRCON ₹20K). | FOR ₹10 LAKH FRESH CAPITAL: ETFs 35% (₹3.5L: Nifty 50 ₹1.2L, Next 50 ₹1L, Midcap 150 ₹70K, Bank ETF ₹40K, Gold ₹20K). Stocks 65% (₹6.5L): Large/midcaps under ₹1000 (₹3L: FINCABLES ₹50K, LTFOODS ₹40K, GPIL ₹50K, RVNL ₹50K, BEL ₹40K, LXCHEM ₹30K, NATCOPHARM ₹25K, MOTILALOFS ₹25K, IRCON ₹30K, ASTERDM ₹25K, SEQUENT ₹35K). Quality large-caps (₹2.5L: AIA ₹60K, HITACHI ₹40K, CDSL ₹40K, TIINDIA ₹50K, BRIGADE ₹50K, SYNGENE ₹60K). Smallcaps/momentum (₹1L: PARAS ₹30K, SOLAR ₹30K, HAL ₹40K). RISK MANAGEMENT: Keep 20% in ETFs, 50% in stocks under ₹1000 per investor preference, 30% in quality large-caps. Stagger entry over 4-6 weeks. Set stop losses religiously. Review quarterly. Geopolitical escalation = increase Gold ETF to 15%, reduce cyclicals. VIX spike above 25 = pause fresh deployment.
